WITH filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_order_number, ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
filtered_web_returns AS (
    SELECT wr_reason_sk, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN reason ON wr_reason_sk = r_reason_sk
    WHERE wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998)
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
    SELECT ca_state, ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
filtered_demographics AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'D' OR cd_marital_status = 'S' OR cd_marital_status = 'U')
      AND (cd_education_status = 'Primary' OR cd_education_status = 'College' OR cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
),
filtered_states AS (
    SELECT ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
)
SELECT r_reason_desc, AVG(ws_quantity), AVG(wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr_fee)
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_returns wr ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
JOIN reason r ON wr_reason_sk = r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_web_sales fws ON ws_item_sk = fws.ws_item_sk AND ws_order_number = fws.ws_order_number
JOIN filtered_web_returns fwrs ON wr_reason_sk = fwrs.wr_reason_sk
JOIN filtered_customer_address fca ON ca_state IN (SELECT ca_state FROM filtered_states) AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
JOIN filtered_demographics fd1 ON wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = fd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_demographics fd2 ON wr_returning_cdemo_sk = fd2.cd_demo_sk
WHERE (fd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND fd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary')
   OR (fd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND fd1.cd_education_status = 'College')
   OR (fd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND fd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY r_reason_desc, AVG(ws_quantity), AVG(wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
